summary: Kensington Capital Acquisition Corp. VI, a SPAC, filed an 8-K announcing the confidential submission of a draft S-4 registration statement with the SEC on August 7, 2026, in connection with its proposed business combination with Nth Cycle, Inc. The parties had entered into a Business Combination Agreement on July 21, 2026. The transaction will be submitted to Kensington shareholders for approval. A joint press release was issued and attached as Exhibit 99.1. The filing provides no deal terms, price, or premium. Watch for the public S-4 filing and shareholder vote timing, with the risk-arb angle centered on completion risks and regulatory review.
